title: Recurring toy/record store in my dreams
content: Not a mall, but still a store. I'll post about my mall dream in another post, because that's a whole 'nother animal. I have had multiple dreams about this pretty big store in an unknown town in the middle of nowhere. It would close late, around 9pm or so, and the front room was filled with collectible toys (this would also show in the windows, which were huge and showed the whole front room). In the back was a huge record store, with records, CDs, cassettes, you name it. The record store would change from dream to dream, sometimes it would look a little more disheveled but sometimes it would look almost like a Victorian library, but the front room always stayed the same. Another really interesting part about this all is that there is a little train, kind of like a kiddie train but both kids and adults can fit on it, that goes throughout the whole store. I always feel so comforted when I have these dreams, and they seem so real. I wish this place was real; I've found places that are similar but nothing like the dreams I've had.
